# NEW 2026-11-23 v17.0 Module 17.0-C2: Byzantine Strong-Route 5 Conquest Directions & John VII Thessaloniki Epilogue (oe_sre_, 0 mainline slots, 0 rules, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v170_byz_finale.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# O(1) zero-slot yearly kernel hook (invoked once per calendar year from oe_gk_yearly_dispatch).
# Self-deduplicates via global_var:oe_sre_ran_y ?= current_year and checks ONLY c:BYZ and c:ROM directly
# (O(1) direct tag scope, zero global country sweeps, zero debug_log, zero edits to legacy oe_sr / oe_j7).
oe_sre_kernel_yearly = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { global_var:oe_sre_ran_y ?= current_year }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_sre_ran_y value = current_year }
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_exists = c:BYZ
				c:BYZ = { is_rebel_country = no }
			}
			c:BYZ = {
				oe_sre_dispatch_yearly = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_exists = c:ROM
				c:ROM = { is_rebel_country = no }
			}
			c:ROM = {
				oe_sre_dispatch_yearly = yes
			}
		}
	}
}
